# Glossary {#sec-glossary}

| Term | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Baseline | Scenario 1: no new policies; every other scenario is compared with it |
| Block | One part of the Mitigation sheet, one function or module in `mitigation/` |
| Bug (`M`, `L`) | A model does not compute what it means to. Prototype bugs (`M`) and legacy bugs (`L`) are fixed, never copied |
| Code (output code) | The name of a result row, shared with Excel-AI: `egy.mit.co2.tot.tot.2` |
| Coded CPAT | This Python model |
| Data step | A computation Excel-AI does on its Inputs sheet from the data, before the model rows |
| Dummy database | `data/Public01/tidy/` in this repository (data edition Public01): public data and the proprietary tables perturbed |
| Excel-AI | The Excel prototypes of CPAT-AI, generated by Python builders (`excel_ai/`) |
| Full database | Every country and the proprietary tables; a private repository |
| Issue (`I`) | A potential improvement: logged and copied as it is for now |
| Known difference | A code where Coded CPAT differs from Excel-AI because it fixes a bug still open in the prototype |
| Legacy CPAT | The original CPAT workbook (`CPAT 1.0pre_465`) |
| `NameOfParameter` | The name of an input in Excel-AI's ScenarioDefinition sheet |
| REFCOL | Excel-AI's reference to the baseline's value of the same row and year |
| Scenario set | A table of inputs, one column per scenario, baseline first |
| Tidy CSV | One table per file, long, keys then value |
